analysis: Policy E V2 Analogue Incremental Value Feasibility
feasibility_conclusion: REJECTED_NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE: The frozen analogue hurdle (prob_up >= 0.60) admits only 0 of 140 candidate entries. Even with reduced hurdles (0.50 or 0.40), correlation with realized net PnL is negligible/negative, and analogue filtering fails to rescue Policy D V2 from transaction friction and trend whip-saw losses.
